attackers_goals: Malicious apps can be used to access the organization's Google data.
description: An identity changed Google Workspace third-party application's security settings.
investigative_actions: Check if the identity intended to perform this action, or look for signs that the user account is compromised (e.g. abnormal logins, unusual activity). Check if the new settings look suspicious. Follow further actions done by the account.
